# RAG Roadmap Requirements Checklist: Fulcrum RAG Roadmap Delivery

**Purpose**: Validate roadmap-level requirement clarity, coverage, safety, and implementation readiness before coding.
**Created**: 2026-04-23
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This checklist is generated by the `/speckit.checklist` workflow based on final spec, plan, tasks, research, and contracts.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Are repair, dry-run, execute, verify, status, resume, cancel, and retry requirements all defined with distinct outcomes? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001-FR-003]
- [ ] CHK002 Are vector coverage states documented for every recallable memory, file chunk, and code chunk, including intentionally-unembedded and legacy cases? [Completeness, Spec §FR-005-FR-006]
- [ ] CHK003 Are unified context result types complete for memory, code chunk, file chunk, graph entity/edge, task, decision, and legacy evidence? [Completeness, Spec §FR-010-FR-012]
- [ ] CHK004 Are code RAG requirements complete for natural-language, path, symbol, package/module, dependency, recency, parse failure, and line attribution scenarios? [Completeness, Spec §FR-018-FR-023]
- [ ] CHK005 Are graph requirements complete for P1 coverage/rebuild and P2 relationship query modes without mixing their acceptance gates? [Completeness, Spec §FR-024-FR-028, FR-052]
- [ ] CHK006 Are eval requirements complete for fixture suites, live suites, query traces, quality gates, opt-in model-heavy cases, and zero expected-case readiness? [Completeness, Spec §FR-029-FR-036, FR-046, FR-050]
- [ ] CHK007 Are runtime truth and optional runtime adoption requirements complete for requested/actual values, fallback, fail-closed behavior, local-first parity, and rollback proof? [Completeness, Spec §FR-037-FR-044]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK008 Is "healthy RAG state" defined with exact domain status rules rather than a general trust claim? [Clarity, Spec §Terminology, FR-045]
- [ ] CHK009 Is the default repair behavior clearly separated from explicit clean-slate rebuild behavior? [Clarity, Spec §Clarifications, FR-051]
- [ ] CHK010 Are "operator-facing" and "agent-facing" path exposure rules specific enough to prevent divergent implementations? [Clarity, Spec §Clarifications, FR-048]
- [ ] CHK011 Are expensive rerank and graph expansion bounds required to be documented and surfaced in explain output? [Clarity, Spec §FR-049]
- [ ] CHK012 Is contextual index text clearly defined as retrieval-only and separate from canonical source snippets? [Clarity, Spec §Terminology, FR-016]
- [ ] CHK013 Are optional runtime/store defaults blocked by explicit gates rather than subjective "better quality" language? [Clarity, Spec §FR-043-FR-044]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK014 Do spec, plan, contracts, and tasks consistently name the repair-plan tool as `get_rag_repair_plan`? [Consistency, Contracts §MCP / Action Tool Parity]
- [ ] CHK015 Do health status terms stay consistent across spec, plan, data model, and contracts? [Consistency, Spec §FR-045, Data Model §RAG Health Domain]
- [ ] CHK016 Do task phases preserve the P1/P2 split where graph coverage is P1 but relationship modes are P2? [Consistency, Tasks §Phase 6]
- [ ] CHK017 Do unified search contracts preserve focused `recall_knowledge` and `search_code` compatibility while making `search_context` agent-preferred? [Consistency, Spec §FR-011, Contracts §Unified Context Search]
- [ ] CHK018 Do eval requirements and tasks consistently keep model-heavy and accelerator-heavy cases opt-in? [Consistency, Spec §FR-036, Tasks §US5]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK019 Can SC-001 be objectively evaluated from a repair plan plus final health report without reading implementation internals? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001]
- [ ] CHK020 Can SC-002 be measured from persisted or reported coverage records for all recallable evidence? [Measurability, Spec §SC-002]
- [ ] CHK021 Can SC-004 and SC-005 be evaluated from fixture queries with explicit expected domains, files, and line ranges? [Measurability, Spec §SC-004-SC-005]
- [ ] CHK022 Can live eval failure for missing vector or graph coverage be determined without model judgment? [Measurability, Spec §SC-006]
- [ ] CHK023 Are runtime mismatch success criteria objective for both fail-closed and allowed fallback cases? [Measurability, Spec §SC-009]
- [ ] CHK024 Are optional runtime comparison outcomes measurable across recall quality, grounding, provenance, latency, device use, and rollback status? [Measurability, Spec §SC-010]

## Scenario Coverage

- [ ] CHK025 Are primary operator flows covered from health inspection through repair planning, execution, verification, and retry? [Coverage, Spec §User Story 1]
- [ ] CHK026 Are agent retrieval flows covered for broad context search and focused compatibility tools? [Coverage, Spec §User Story 2]
- [ ] CHK027 Are developer code-search flows covered for semantic-only, symbol, path, dependency, and stale parse/index cases? [Coverage, Spec §User Story 3]
- [ ] CHK028 Are relationship-recall flows covered for available, stale, failed, and disabled graph states? [Coverage, Spec §User Story 4]
- [ ] CHK029 Are eval and observability flows covered for fixture pass/fail, live coverage degradation, trace inspection, and path redaction? [Coverage, Spec §User Story 5]
- [ ] CHK030 Are optional runtime experiment flows covered for unavailable adapters, worse-than-baseline results, rollback, and default adoption denial? [Coverage, Spec §User Story 6]

## Edge Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK031 Are empty, stale, failed, skipped, intentionally-unembedded, and legacy coverage states all represented in requirements and data model? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK032 Are concurrent source changes during repair, rebuild, or eval addressed by freshness or snapshot requirements? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK033 Are vector rows without matching metadata and metadata without vector rows explicitly handled? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK034 Are parse failures, moved files, and stale code line ranges represented as explicit states? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK035 Are missing expected live eval cases defined as degraded readiness rather than success? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-046]
- [ ] CHK036 Are secret-bearing config, raw env values, and unintended absolute paths excluded from non-operator artifacts? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-040, FR-048]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [ ] CHK037 Are assumptions about existing lifecycle hardening from feature 001 explicitly reflected in plan dependencies? [Assumption, Plan §Summary]
- [ ] CHK038 Are official-source research decisions linked to requirements or plan slices where they affect product behavior? [Traceability, Research §Source-Grounded Decisions]
- [ ] CHK039 Are package ownership boundaries documented for every planned implementation surface? [Dependency, Plan §Project Structure]
- [ ] CHK040 Are new CLI/MCP/action surfaces traceable from spec requirements to contracts and tasks? [Traceability, Contracts §MCP / Action Tool Parity]
